tasks.title: Fix ModelSelect Popover for Headless UI v2
tasks.description: Remove the `<Transition>` wrapper from `Popover.Panel` in the `ModelSelect` component (AiSettingsSection.tsx lines 257–322). The bare `Popover.Panel` will handle its own show/hide via Headless UI v2's Popover context. Also remove the unused `Fragment` import if no longer needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Mohist Model 选择器点击后 Popover Panel 渲染到 DOM 并显示模型列表
Coder Model 选择器点击后 Popover Panel 渲染到 DOM 并显示模型列表
Stage Model Overrides 中的选择器点击后正常打开
搜索过滤、键盘导航、Provider 分组功能完整保留
Transition wrapper 已移除，Popover.Panel 直接作为 Popover 子元素
tasks.notes: The Transition wrapper at lines 257-265 and its closing tag at line 322 are the entire bug. Remove them, keeping Popover.Panel and all its children intact. Remove Fragment from imports if unused.

tasks.title: Restructure AI Settings page layout and provider sections
tasks.spec: specs/web-ui/spec.md#AI Settings 页面布局顺序
tasks.description: Reorder `AiSettingsSection` JSX so sections appear as: Model Selection → Stage Model Overrides → Connected Providers (expanded) → Available Providers (collapsed with count) → Custom Providers. Add a `useState` for Available Providers collapse state. Keep provider search above the combined provider area.
acceptanceCriteria: Model Selection 区域是页面第一个可见区域（Mohist Model + Coder Model）
Stage Model Overrides 紧跟 Model Selection 之后
Connected Providers 区域默认展开，显示已配置的 provider 卡片
Available Providers 区域默认折叠，标题显示数量如 'Available (78)'
点击 Available Providers 标题可展开/折叠列表
Custom Providers 在 Available Providers 之后
无已配置 provider 时 Model Selection 仍可访问
tasks.notes: Use existing `configuredProviders`, `unconfiguredProviders`, `customProviders` memos. Add `availableProvidersOpen` useState defaulting to false. Use ChevronRightIcon (already defined) for collapse toggle with rotate-90 when open, same pattern as Stage Model Overrides.
